parole.testo: Uncertain, perhaps a loan word from a Chuvash-type Turkic language.

From a Chuvash-type Turkic language before the times of the Hungarian conquest of the Carpathian Basin (at the turn of the 9th and 10th centuries), compare Cuman Kipchak [script needed] (učuχ, “chaff”), Turkmen [script needed] (uǰuq, “refuse grain”), and Tatar [script needed] (očoq, “chaff”), ultima
